paragraphs: Chapter 454
Episode 130. New Year, False Rumors, Great Project (3)
January 1, 1800.
The new year had come.
Tikan's family gathered at the Litra teahouse, humbly blessing each other's year.
The sound of children crunching on cookies with their teeth was pleasant to hear, and candles scattered around emitted colorful lights.
The smell of baking bread and cookies was delightful, and the magical aroma that Ratri created in the kitchen made everyone's mouths water, regardless of their age.
It was a truly rustic yet sophisticated scene for the first day of the new year. The old dog Puffy yawned and walked towards the children.
The reason Puffy moved away from where he was sitting was that there were rough-looking men with dark faces that contrasted with the warm atmosphere sitting at the tables nearby.
They hadn't changed out of their blood-stained clothes, and they hadn't even combed their disheveled hair.
They frowned the whole time, tapping the table with their fingers and expressing their extreme displeasure with their entire bodies.

They were the captains and executives of the Black King's group. They didn't bother to change their clothes as a way of showing their loyalty, as if they were still fighting alongside the confused Valkas.
The reason they were here on the first day of the new year, instead of in the Bise Kingdom, was that they couldn't salvage the fallen Black King's fortress themselves.
To be precise, they had been deprived of that right.
It was because of Runcandel.
In 1800, amidst the beginning of a new century, the star of Runcandel's 12th generation shone first.
The world's best mercenary group, the Black King's group! The reason they joined the 12th generation as a subordinate.
Black King's group leader, Valkas Kran, swore loyalty to the 12th generation in secret in Tikan Free City...
The black pearl of the Bise Kingdom, which no major power could embrace, now belonged to Runcandel.
In 1799, which was virtually Jin Runcandel's year, will his momentum continue this year?
The war between the 12th generation and the Black King's group was one of the biggest events of the previous century, with the winners being the 12th generation and Runcandel.
The Emperor of the Sky, the great black dragon! Murakan roars its fearsome cry again in the world.
The dragon among dragons, ruler of the skies. The name that even Zephyr fears! Myu. Ra. Kan.
"Ha!"
The members of the Black King's group sighed and groaned as they read the newspapers on the table.
Each word, each letter, was so full of injustice and infuriating content that they couldn't understand how it could be so.
They wanted to confront Runcandel and ask how little they thought of them to do such a thing and when they had ever said they would join the 12th generation.
After the articles poured out.
Runcandel prevented the Heukwangdan from getting involved in the recovery of the Heukwang Castle by sending knights and people.
Externally, it seemed as if Runcandel was taking over the work on behalf of the 'distracted Heukwangdan' as a royal family.

In reality, it meant that now Heukwangdan belonged to Runcandel and should follow their control. It was also an act to make it clear once again to external forces and saints that Heukwangdan belonged to them.
It was infuriating.
Not only was it unacceptable to lose their territory in an instant, but also to endure this humiliation...!
Crunch!
Grit!
The sound of children breaking snacks and the Heukwangdan grinding their teeth contrasted.
It was as if a line was drawn in the middle of a canvas and completely different pictures were drawn on each side. Where the Tikan family was and where the Heukwangdan were sitting.
"How about relaxing your faces, friends?"
One person came over from Tikan's side to the table of the Heukwangdan and sat down.

"The lord has prepared such a wonderful place for us, do you think it's okay to keep sitting there with a bug-eaten face? Have any of you ever had such cookies in your mercenary life? It's my first time."
It was Ghost Captain Lata Proch. He was there to pay respects to Jin on the first day of the New Year.
Lata's younger brother, Fey Proch, also came over and added a word.
"Yeah, don't look so fierce when there are kids around. It makes me want to tear you all apart."

The relationship between the Ghost Squad and the Heukwangdan was not good. Especially Lata, who had been rated as the lowest among the three mercenaries, had been waiting for an opportunity to reverse the situation.
Now that he became a close aide to Jin, his ambition was not as strong as before, but it was unbearable to see Heukwangdan showing such an attitude.
"What?"
"What do you mean, friend? Other than Commander Valkas, none of you have higher status than me. We're going to be eating from the same pot soon, so we should make sure the hierarchy is clear."
"One pot? Who says we're eating with you!"
When one officer shouted, a playful light filled Lata's eyes.
Then the officer flinched, and the commanders tensed their eyes. Lata let out a restrained chuckle as if to hold back.

"I understand how you feel, but now is not the time for that. Why can't you read the situation as it turns around? When Commander Valkas wakes up, what kind of decision do you think he'll make? Do you really think he'll say he'll become a neutral force again?"
There was a tense atmosphere between Lata and the Heukwangdan. As Lata said, Valkas had not yet regained consciousness.
Immediately after the Heukwangdan incident, Jin headed straight to the Holy Kingdom with Valkas and the Black Knight.
Holy Queen Lani, only she, not anyone else, could neutralize the poison of Zepherin.
This time, even Lani couldn't heal them with pure divine power alone.
She requested 500 medicinal herbs for the treatment, including some rare items that could only be obtained by classifying them as first-class missions even in Runcandel.

Thanks to this, Jin and some of his colleagues spent their days busy without a moment's rest until the dawn of the New Year. They explored the uncharted lands of various countries, traveled through dangerous areas and unprotected zones to gather medicinal herbs.
Among them, Lata and his Ghost Squad, along with Kujan, suffered the most.
However, Lata had no intention of letting the Black Knights, who were holding back their anger, know that fact.
It was because he thought that they had gone through all the trouble not for the Black Knights, but for their lord.
"… Lord Lata, do you really think our leader will submit to the 12th generation?"

"Of course. I don't want to admit it, but Lord Valkas is superior to me in every way. Strength, resourcefulness, judgment, experience, etc. Oh, I might be more annoying in terms of personality. And my liver might be bigger."
"You're also more handsome, brother."

Fey jokingly said that and made a gagging gesture. The siblings were usually very affectionate, but they didn't seem to consider each other beautiful. It felt more like flattering each other in public.

"Anyway. That's Valkas. Can I miss what I've seen and read? Right now, becoming the lord's force is the best and only choice. The Black Knights might be alienated from both Runcandel and Zipple if they keep acting up. That could lead to their destruction."
"That's a matter for our leader to decide after he wakes up. It's not for you to argue."
"Fine, but the way these guys have been talking is really annoying…"
"Hey, you mercenary scum. Are there just four of you? If you think the Hidden Palace is a joke, do you want us to teach you a lesson?"
It was Ryu and Hiten of the Hidden Palace 7 Swords, who were staying in Tikan under the command of Talaris. They were sitting on the Tikan family's side, enjoying tea and cookies.
"Ha! What did you say? Say that again…!"
Squeak!
At the moment when Lata and the Black Knights got angry, the door opened and a voice came in.
"Hey, what's with all these gloomy guys on New Year's Day? Huh? Are you guys fighting? You didn't really fight, did you? The kids are playing over there."
It was Murakan. At his voice, Lata and Fey immediately saluted, and the Black Knights coughed and looked away.
"We apologize."
"Quicantel, you should have said something. Fighting on New Year's Day, what a mess."
"I left them alone because I thought they might die if they lost."
"Oh, okay. Good job. Latree, bring some cookies quickly. The smell is really great."
"I was curious about how far they'd go."
Next to Murakan were Jin, Valkas wrapped in bandages all over his body, the Black Knight wrapped in bandages and carried on a stretcher, and the Holy Queen Lani wearing a hood.
The Black Knight was still unconscious.
As Lani removed her hood, a deep and sacred aura seemed to envelop the inside of the snack shop.
Unconsciously, the mercenaries bowed their heads at her strange dignity.
They couldn't help but feel more humbled, knowing that she was treating their leader.
"Your Majesty, the Holy King!"
"Today, I am here as a friend of Tikan, so do not feel burdened. Please, mercenaries, raise your heads."
Then, Lani casually shrugged at Jin and Valkas.
"Anyway, looking at the atmosphere, it seems like you two will have a hard time ahead. In any case, give me some cookies quickly. I have to go back to the New Year's celebration ceremony."
She had secretly visited Tikan during the break of the celebration ceremony. Lani then naturally mingled with Tikan's family, and the Black King members raised their voices.
"Leader!"
"Are you alright?"
"I'm fine, so stop making a fuss. And everyone, stop acting foolishly and straighten up."
At Valkas's words, the Black King members lined up and bowed their heads.
"Shall I talk, or would you like to say something, Sir Valkas?"
Jin said, watching the scene.
Jin and Valkas had already finished discussing the future of the Black King before coming to Tikan.
"Let me speak. It seems like this is my last chance to talk as an independent leader of the Black King."
At those words, the Black King members' eyes widened, and Lata nodded as if he knew it would happen.
The Black King members never thought Valkas would accept this forced choice.
Valkas was fully aware that this was the only way for the Black King to survive, as Lata had predicted.

"Starting today, the Black King will serve the 12th Regiment as our lord. This means that we will serve not just as a leader tied to the mercenary world by money, but as a ruler of a blood alliance bound by loyalty and faith."
The Black King members had stronger trust in Valkas than Lata, who had completely controlled the Ghost Army except for some elders.
The members were taken aback by his sudden decision, but they soon composed themselves and nodded.
"Yes, Leader!"

"From now on, we will move all the equipment at the Black King Mountain to Tikan Free City. Since the whole Tikan Free City will be undergoing renovation, everyone, prepare to move the equipment with utmost focus."
That was the moment when Tikan's largest defense system was determined.
